page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc6e.26xlarge is a compute-focused instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor using the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 104 dedicated vCPUs and 192.0 GB of RAM, configured on a KVM hypervisor. This resource ratio provides approximately 1.85 GB of memory per core. Network operations are supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, while complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The instance does not include integrated graphics processing units (0.0 GPUs) or local block storage disks. Applications deployed on this configuration must utilize external network-attached storage for persistent data. The low memory-to-vCPU allocation prioritizes CPU core density over system memory volume, making the instance suited for CPU-bound computational tasks, highly parallel workloads, batch processing, and high-throughput network-dependent applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc6e.26xlarge is a compute-focused instance powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY CPU. Managed under a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 104 dedicated vCPUs paired with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing roughly 1.85 GB of memory per vCPU core. The server configuration excludes local storage disks and discrete GPUs, relying on attached network storage for disk operations. High-speed networking capabilities are backed by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The low memory-to-vCPU ratio optimizes resource allocation for highly parallel, CPU-bound workloads where processing core capacity is prioritized over large RAM footprints. The ecs.ebmc6e.26xlarge is well-matched for parallel compute jobs, heavy batch processing, high-throughput network tasks, and software compilation workloads.
